gates.required: Half-lowered iron lattice inside entrance with crossing bars and pointed lower teeth
gates.evidence: Large half-lowered lattice, cross bars and pointed teeth clearly appear in central arch.

gates.required: Both side guide grooves visible with open passage beneath grille
gates.evidence: Open vaulted passage passes. Continuous guide grooves containing both grille edges are not shown; outer upright dark channels sit apart from grille behind the stone arch.

gates.required: Two substantial flanking towers connected by a chamber above a single central passage
gates.evidence: Two cylindrical stone towers flank one central passage and are joined by the upper masonry chamber.

gates.required: Long dark wavy hair, brown eyes and broadly matching visible face shape
gates.evidence: Woman has long dark wavy hair and a softly oval face with similar lip/nose proportions; visible eye appears brown at available scale. This is appearance comparison, not identity verification.

gates.required: Woman visibly carries rolled linen banner beside opening, leaving grille legible
gates.evidence: She supports a rolled linen banner at waist height with both hands, stands beside entrance and leaves lattice unobstructed.
